categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Zhongke Magnetic Industry Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of permanent magnetic materials, including sintered NdFeB permanent magnets and ferrite magnets. The company serves diversified markets such as consumer electronics, energy-efficient home appliances, robotics, low-altitude economy, automotive industry, and industrial equipment. It operates a vertically integrated business model extending along the magnetic materials value chain.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered core technologies for high-performance rare earth permanent magnets, including low/no heavy rare earth NdFeB magnet production, high-precision processing, and intelligent inspection systems. It employs proprietary raw material formulations and advanced manufacturing processes such as wet pressing, sintering, and boundary diffusion techniques. Production emphasizes customization, high consistency, and automation to meet diverse client specifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global leading brands in consumer electronics (e.g., Samsung, Huawei, Xiaomi, Amazon), energy-efficient appliances (e.g., Midea, Gree), automotive, and industrial sectors. The company targets mid-to-high-end markets with applications in speakers, sensors, motors, robotics, drones, and electric vehicles. Its products support emerging sectors like AI, humanoid robots, and low-altitude economy aviation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Dongyang, Zhejiang Province, China, a major magnetic materials production hub. It operates subsidiaries in Singapore and Vietnam, serving both domestic and international markets. Approximately 88.74% of revenue is from domestic sales, with the remainder from overseas markets, primarily Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Zhongke Magnetic Industry operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the production of permanent magnetic materials. It is expanding upstream by developing self-produced raw materials like ferrite pre-sintered powders and downstream by integrating magnetic components and assemblies to enhance product value.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in high-performance NdFeB magnets and ferrite magnets, focusing on cost reduction, resource efficiency, and product performance enhancement. R&D projects include multi-element diffusion, high-Ce content magnets, and low-cobalt ferrite magnets. It aims to deepen vertical integration, digital transformation, and expand into emerging application fields such as robotics, new energy vehicles, and industrial automation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of customized permanent magnets and related magnetic components. Sales channels include direct sales and consignment sales, with contracts based on customer orders or framework agreements. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income from financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the leading domestic producers of permanent magnets, with competitive advantages in technology, product quality, and customer base. It competes with other Chinese firms like North Rare Earth, Ningbo Funeng Rare Earth, and Hengdian Group Dongci. While foreign competitors dominate high-end markets, Zhejiang Zhongke is closing the technology gap and expanding its global market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 546 million, a 12.75% increase year-over-year, but net profit declined by 65.59% to RMB 16.56 million due to raw material price declines and intensified competition. Total assets grew 8.37% to RMB 1.58 billion. The company is investing heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, with a focus on sustainable growth despite short-term profit pressure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Zhongke Magnetic Industry emphasizes high-performance, highly consistent, and customized permanent magnets tailored to client specifications. Its unique value lies in proprietary raw material formulas, advanced manufacturing processes, and strong customer service, enabling it to serve high-end applications requiring miniaturization, precision, and reliability. The company leverages its integrated supply chain and innovation capabilities to offer comprehensive magnetic material solutions.
